QuestInfo.name: Reunion after Centuries
QuestInfo.0: You hear a voice in your head. Is the darkness in your soul seeping into your brain?\n\n#b<This quest will start your 2nd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
QuestInfo.1: You hear a voice in your head. Is the darkness in your soul seeping into your brain?\n\n#b<This quest will start your 2nd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
QuestInfo.2: Vieren, who studied magic with you in Aurora centuries ago, wants to have a little chat. #bDouble-click#k on his #bVampiric Lantern#k to move to Harmony in Aurora.

0.1: Can you hear the sound of my voice?\r\n#L0##bI know that voice... Vieren? Is that you?#l\n#k
0.2: That's right! I knew you'd remember me, even after all these centuries. Come drop by and we can catch up. I'm in Harmony these days.\r\n#L0##bHarmony, our old sanctum? I would if I could, old friend, but I've lost my way. I don't know how to get there.#l\n#k
0.3: Psh, no problem! Here, take this. You can use it to get to Harmony.

yes.0: I already charged that sucker up, so come on over whenever you feel like it.

no.0: Come now! That's no way to treat an old friend.
